title: sysc-metrics M2: power and thermal collectors
description: Unbuilt and undesigned upstream work that gates Tranche 3C. Filed in the repo itself as https://github.com/Nomadcxx/sysc-metrics/issues/1 so it is visible to whoever picks that module up. External repo /home/nomadx/sysc-metrics at v0.1.0: no Go file mentions battery, thermal, upower or power_supply. Its design specifies the contract: thermal-zone parsing, UPower DisplayDevice preferred, sysfs power-supply fallback, source-transition handling, multi-battery, and suspend/resume qualification on real hardware. Tranche 3C's design assumes a provisional BatterySnapshot shape recorded in that issue; a divergence triggers a reconciliation pass rather than a redesign. Needs its own design and plan there, then a v0.2.0 release tag.
